assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: main editorial photograph for a Korean fashion show invitation website mockup. Primary request: create a refined avant-garde fashion editorial photograph, portrait 2:3 composition. Scene: warm pale ivory photographic studio with a tall translucent scrim and soft sculptural shadow. Subject: one adult East Asian female fashion model in a fully opaque sculptural black tailored dress with voluminous pleated ivory fabric wrapped over one shoulder, standing confidently, head and full garment visible, natural elegant pose, slick dark hair. Style: independent fashion magazine, shot on medium-format film, photorealistic natural skin texture, tactile fabric, subtle grain, restrained and sophisticated. Composition: full-length figure occupying the central 65 percent, generous breathing room, usable for both portrait and square web crops. Lighting: soft directional daylight with deep but natural fabric shadows. Palette: ivory, ink black, muted warm grey. No writing, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no border, no collage, no UI. Produce the photograph itself.
